1.  Through this application, the Petitioner requests for a change of a date in the present petition. The Petitioner has also placed on record a letter dated 6th June, 2024, issued by the Respondent - i.e.,
Food Safety and Standards Authority of India,1 to the Petitioner, wherein they have stated that the matter related to Petitioner's revised formulation is still under scientific scrutiny and "FSSAI"
This is a digitally signed order. 
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above. The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 11/07/2024 at 21:12:00 they are agreeable to grant the interim extension to the Petitioner till 30th September, 2024. 
2. 1 for impleadment in the present petition.
3. Re-notify on 22nd October, 2024.
4. The date already fixed i.e. 15th July, 2024 stands cancelled.
5. Interim order to continue(s), if any.
